in_sanskrit.name: अनय

in_marathi.name: Anay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Anay means 'Breath' or 'Life'. In Hindu mythology, Anay is the Vedic god of breath, wind, and the sky. He is also considered a form of the god Vayu and the god of life.
